notesZh:
局域网代理端口：
- 新增「代理端口」独立页面，可开设多个局域网 HTTP / SOCKS / 混合代理端口，给单台设备或单个应用配置代理，无需改动整机网关。
- 每个端口可独立开启账号密码鉴权，未携带凭据的连接会被拒绝。
- 每个端口可独立选择出口：跟随分流、自动选择、指定分组或节点、直连，与设备策略含义一致。
- 端口仅对局域网及组网接口开放，广域网侧不可达。
notesEn:
LAN proxy ports:
- New dedicated "Proxy ports" page: open multiple LAN-facing HTTP / SOCKS / mixed proxy ports, so a single device or application can use a proxy without changing its gateway.
- Each port can require its own username and password; connections without credentials are refused.
- Each port can pick its own exit: follow routing, auto select, a specific group or node, or direct — same semantics as device policies.
- Ports are reachable only from the LAN and mesh interfaces, never from the WAN side.
